verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Scheduled Flags, which apply a flag change once at a specified future time, and Release Pipelines, which move flags through stages via triggers. Neither is documented as a recurring schedule (cron-style or repeating jobs/workflows). A one-off future change is an adjacent capability, not a recurring one, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
